input._script:
using JSON3, TOML
out = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    depot = first(Base.DEPOT_PATH)
    out["depots"] = Base.DEPOT_PATH; out["julia"] = string(VERSION)
    envdir = dirname(Base.active_project()); out["active_project"] = Base.active_project()
    out["env_files"] = readdir(envdir)
    prj = TOML.parsefile(joinpath(envdir, "Project.toml")); out["project_deps"] = sort(collect(keys(get(prj, "deps", Dict()))))
    man = TOML.parsefile(joinpath(envdir, "Manifest.toml"))
    deps = get(man, "deps", man)
    out["manifest_jacc"] = haskey(deps, "JACC") ? [Dict(k => v for (k, v) in e if k in ("version", "git-tree-sha1")) for e in deps["JACC"]] : "none"
    out["manifest_cuda"] = haskey(deps, "CUDA") ? [Dict(k => v for (k, v) in e if k in ("version",)) for e in deps["CUDA"]] : "none"
    lp = joinpath(envdir, "LocalPreferences.toml"); out["local_preferences"] = isfile(lp) ? read(lp, String) : "none"
    pk = joinpath(depot, "packages", "JACC")
    out["jacc_package_dirs"] = Dict(d => (isfile(joinpath(pk, d, "Project.toml")) ? TOML.parsefile(joinpath(pk, d, "Project.toml"))["version"] : "?") for d in readdir(pk))
    comp = joinpath(depot, "compiled", "v$(VERSION.major).$(VERSION.minor)")
    out["compiled_jacc_dirs"] = [d for d in readdir(comp) if occursin("JACC", d)]
    # registry: JACC versions
    regs = joinpath(depot, "registries")
    vers = String[]
    for r in readdir(regs)
        f = joinpath(regs, r, "J", "JACC", "Versions.toml")
        isfile(f) && append!(vers, collect(keys(TOML.parsefile(f))))
        # registries unpacked as tarballs are not scanned here
    end
    out["registry_versions"] = sort(vers, by = v -> VersionNumber(v))
    out["registries"] = readdir(regs)
    out["depot_free_gb"] = round(parse(Float64, split(read(`df -P --block-size=1G $depot`, String), '\n')[2] |> x -> split(x)[4]); digits = 0)
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 2000)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
